name: Leo
appearance: A cute, stylized 3D lion with a rounded body, golden-yellow fur, and a disproportionately large, fluffy, bright orange mane that looks like a sunburst. He has large, expressive eyes and a small, pink nose.
clothing: A short, royal purple velvet cape fastened with a single circular gold clasp at the neck.
accessories: A small, shimmering gold crown that is slightly too small for his head and always sits tilted to the left.
color_palette: Golden Yellow, Bright Orange, Royal Purple, Shimmering Gold
personality: Pompous, grumpy, and self-important. He believes he is the supreme ruler of the jungle, though he is more comical than menacing. He is easily frustrated but has a secret soft spot for naps.
strengths: Unshakable confidence, loud presence, natural leadership instincts.
weaknesses: Over-confidence, easily distracted by snacks, terrified of tiny butterflies.
goals: To be officially acknowledged as the 'Boss of the Jungle' by every animal.
default_expression: A cute scowl with one eyebrow raised and a slight pout.
default_pose: Standing tall with chest puffed out and paws resting firmly on his hips.
movement_style: Stiff, formal walking with dramatic, exaggerated turns; occasionally trips over his own cape.
gestures: Crossing arms stubbornly, pointing a single paw authoritatively, tossing his mane with a flick of his head.
voice_style: Booming and theatrical, yet slightly raspy and comical.
catch_phrase: I am the Boss of the Brush!
image_prompt: A cute stylized 3D animation character of a grumpy golden-yellow lion. He has a large fluffy bright orange mane, wearing a small tilted gold crown and a short royal purple velvet cape with a gold clasp.
